description: Add a checksum annotation of the ConfigMap's contents to the pod template so editing the ConfigMap actually triggers a rollout instead of silently doing nothing
prompts: k8s/configmap.yaml and k8s/deployment.yaml exist for the pricing-api Deployment, which mounts the ConfigMap as env vars via envFrom. Kubernetes does NOT restart pods when a ConfigMap they reference changes - editing k8s/configmap.yaml and re-applying it updates the ConfigMap object but the running pods keep their stale env vars until something ELSE forces a rollout. Add a pod template annotation checksum/config on k8s/deployment.yaml whose value is the literal string "REPLACE_WITH_SHA256_OF_CONFIGMAP_DATA" (a placeholder a deploy pipeline would compute and substitute - you do not need to compute a real hash here, just add the annotation key in the right place) so that changing it on every deploy forces the pod template to change, which forces a rollout.

setup_files.k8s/configmap.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: pricing-api-config
  namespace: default
data:
  FEATURE_FLAGS: "new_pricing=true"
  CACHE_TTL_SECONDS: "300"
setup_files.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: pricing-api
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: pricing-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: pricing-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: pricing-api
          image: ghcr.io/example/pricing-api:2.3.0
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: pricing-api-config

test_setup_files.check_checksum.py:
import yaml

with open("k8s/deployment.yaml") as f:
    dep = yaml.safe_load(f)

pod_meta = dep["spec"]["template"]["metadata"]
annotations = pod_meta.get("annotations") or {}
assert "checksum/config" in annotations, (
    "pod template is missing a checksum/config annotation - without something in the pod "
    "template changing on every deploy, editing the ConfigMap alone never triggers a rollout")
assert annotations["checksum/config"], "checksum/config annotation must not be empty"

envfrom = dep["spec"]["template"]["spec"]["containers"][0].get("envFrom") or []
assert any((e.get("configMapRef") or {}).get("name") == "pricing-api-config" for e in envfrom), (
    "the existing envFrom -> pricing-api-config wiring must stay intact")

with open("k8s/configmap.yaml") as f:
    cm = yaml.safe_load(f)
assert cm["data"]["FEATURE_FLAGS"] == "new_pricing=true", "ConfigMap data must stay unchanged"

print("PASS checksum annotation checks")

reference_solution.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: pricing-api
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: pricing-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: pricing-api
      annotations:
        checksum/config: "REPLACE_WITH_SHA256_OF_CONFIGMAP_DATA"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: pricing-api
          image: ghcr.io/example/pricing-api:2.3.0
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: pricing-api-config
